prompt: Hand-drawn INK ILLUSTRATION on a painted wood panel, visible wood grain showing faintly through the paint. Strictly limited palette: pale blue-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black shapes, white, and ONE accent of hot coral-red used sparingly. Texture made entirely by HAND-DRAWN HATCHING — fine contour lines following forms, chevron and zigzag fills, crosshatch — never by soft gradients or glow. Bold flat black negative space. Naive folk-art woodcut quality, confident ink line, slightly irregular by hand. No text, no lettering. A tall ancient standing stone rising huge in the frame, drawn with fine contour hatching following the rock, moss on one shoulder drawn as dense stipple. Slim modern instrument bands and a small box fitted to it, drawn in clean ink line. A vertical column of marks cut into its face glows as FLAT HOT CORAL strokes — the only colour. At its base, dwarfed, one tiny flat-black silhouette creature looks up at it. Behind, flat black sky and a low horizon of hatched chevron mountains with small coral peaks. Enormous stone, tiny creature.
